desc:
An accurate replica of the hit game Chicken Gun by ChaloApps. Embark with friends through the roleplay world of our fan game. Level up to unlock, test out varieties of weapons, and a massive amount of customization combos!
Earn coins through jobs and gamemodes. 

V1.0.0

Minimum Memory: 4GB
Recommended Memory: 6GB

Any in-game purchases are greatly appreciated!
Roblox Plus+ benefits are supported.

<Our Group>:
*Involve yourself in our group by recommending accessories and game ideas!

🔴 We do NOT sell shares or the game in any amount. Watch out for scams! 🔴
